directive: owner OD-001 (2026-10-14), P0-B: "a smaller, reliably green production-critical test gate"
IS_NOT: a full-suite result. The full suite (python3.12 nfl/tests/run_suite.py) stays the authoritative baseline; the gate is the subset every production release must pass on its own head.
STRICTER_THAN_THE_SUITE: a BLOCKED function fails the gate: a release guard that could not run has guarded nothing
admission_rule: a module is admitted only when it guards a production release path and was green with zero BLOCKED functions in two consecutive gate runs on the same head; a module that depends on network or remote git state is not admitted, however important, because its colour would measure the environment

excluded_with_reason.test_spending_gate: ENV: asserts the local origin/main ref is current against the remote (red on 2026-10-14 with a stale ref, code unchanged); stays in the full suite
excluded_with_reason.test_autonomy_transport: ENV: same remote-ref dependence (ENV-D1); stays in the full suite
excluded_with_reason.test_qb2_production: TEST-D9 open: 5 failing checks on an incomplete draw-artifact fixture
excluded_with_reason.test_field_model: FIREWALL-D1 open: red on a real defect; admitted when fixed
excluded_with_reason.test_dfs_eligibility: guards nfl/dfs eligibility code that no production entrypoint imports (static call graph)
excluded_with_reason.test_dfs_identity_crosswalk: guards an identity crosswalk that no production entrypoint imports (static call graph)

categories.ELIGIBILITY: roster eligibility: three-state contract, withheld before projection, upload refusal (OD-001 decision 1)
categories.POINT_IN_TIME: no information after the cutoff reaches a forecast; replays declare themselves (PIT-D1)
categories.RELEASE_AND_LOCK: release status, kickoff refusal, diagnostic withholding, final upload verification (ENG-014/017)
categories.LINEUP_RULES_AND_SELECTION: DK roster rules, stacking, exposure caps and the governed selector
categories.MARKET_AND_FC_FIREWALL: no sportsbook, FC or DK AvgPoints input reaches a projection
categories.IDENTITY: the right game, club and player keys end to end
categories.STATE_BUILDERS: Classic state builder and Sunday prelock fixtures
categories.GOVERNANCE_AND_HARNESS: mode boundaries, the runner's own counting and tree guard, the issue ledger
